harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s bin/unpack with a Python 3.5-compatible preflight and staged atomic installer. Normal nested files install successfully; absolute paths, parent traversal, links, and special members are rejected before incoming/ changes. Source archives and protected files remain unchanged. The fix persisted across the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced direct GNU tar extraction with complete member validation before installation.
Added locked staging and atomic publication while preserving existing incoming files.
Tested all supplied normal and malformed archives.
Restarted node1 and repeated health, integrity, and security checks.

evidence.requirement: Ordinary nested files are accepted under incoming/
evidence.summary: incoming/docs/notice.txt exists with expected content and permissions before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Absolute archive paths are rejected without external writes
evidence.summary: absolute.tar was rejected; /outside.txt remained absent and incoming content unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Parent traversal is rejected before any archive members install
evidence.summary: traversal.tar was rejected, its earlier accepted.txt member remained absent, and protected/customer.txt was unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Symlink-based escapes are rejected before installation
evidence.summary: symlink.tar was rejected, incoming/escape remained absent, and protected content was unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Source packages and protected sibling files are preserved
evidence.summary: Package and protected-file SHA-256 hashes match the initial, pre-reboot, and post-reboot states.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID 225ffbf7-477b-4e25-bbae-e26343dd98bd was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 1a42a157-8ee5-4454-b998-d88ff87f94c1 proved restart, and complete post-reboot functional and integrity checks passed.
